live_root_selection_memory_2026_11_05.scope: R1a root selection: pre-admitted live CPU owner for tree/order and staged plugin selection; detach capture observes growth/removal/drop via shared account without capture-time double charge
live_root_selection_memory_2026_11_05.verification: Final scoped groups: 322 distinct passed/7 ignored/0 failed; GPU 29/no SKIP, native STL 60. Original overlay baseline oracle failure retained; exact live selection bill added, timeout/stale assertions unchanged.

stl_shared_admission_peer_2026_11_05.scope: R1a peer portion: reuse the existing shared-account admission peer for STL capture, preserving cache quota at the tested managed ceiling and source authority without a temporary identity/account adoption
stl_shared_admission_peer_2026_11_05.verification: Final stl-peer-20261105-061229: 169 distinct passed/6 large ignored/0 failed; STL unit 60 includes new peer 2, replacement 8, lifecycle 12+20+9, native STL integration 60. Initial zero-test filter run rejected, not evidence.

stl_notes_during_geometry_2026_11_04.limitations: Warning allocation and native and other export owners remain incomplete

stl_process_memory_probe_2026_11_03.scope: Isolated release process memory high-water measurements for STL and tessellation fixtures.
stl_process_memory_probe_2026_11_03.limitations: Whole-process counters, not OCCT-only attribution or safe upper bounds; production admission and desktop remain open.

stl_mesh_allocation_checks_2026_11_03.scope: Checked mesh index bounds, fallible output capacity and periodic cancellation checks during STL assembly.
stl_mesh_allocation_checks_2026_11_03.limitations: No forced OOM or mid-copy cancellation; managed/native peak and background UI remain open.

stl_fallible_topology_allocation_2026_11.scope: Fallible STL topology scratch allocation in application export and strict stream validation.

stl_background_single_slot_2026_11_03.scope: One background STL worker per shared account, held through cancellation and worker exit.

periodic_nurbs_encoded_stl_2026_11_03.scope: Encoded boundary and winding checks plus sampled source-to-STL distances for periodic NURBS fixtures.
periodic_nurbs_encoded_stl_2026_11_03.limitations: Sampled one-way error only; general topology, global deviation, runtime admission and desktop remain unverified.

stl_edge_node_snapshot_2026_11_03.scope: Brep, retained NativeBrep and NURBS STL export uses snapshot-local source-site remap, displacement and triangle checks
stl_edge_node_snapshot_2026_11_03.limitations: Incomplete bindings may leave open mesh. Periodic seams, full error budget, native cancellation, resource admission and native costs remain open.

stl_unverified_seams_2026_11_03.scope: OCCT and retained NativeBrep export groups mesh faces by source shell, preserving tested close-solid and cavity boundaries
stl_unverified_seams_2026_11_03.limitations: Shell grouping is not edge identity; nearby features within a shell, unowned faces and direct NURBS remain unprotected. Native conversion and tessellation costs and reservations are unmeasured.

stl_receipt_scope_2026_11_03.scope: Captured STL document identity and honest requested tolerance, topology, self-intersection and units reporting
stl_receipt_scope_2026_11_03.limitations: Does not prove global deviation, encoded topology or absence of self-intersection; desktop presentation unverified.

stl_quantization_collision_2026_11_03.scope: Reject distinct input positions merged by binary STL quantization while preserving the destination on failure
stl_quantization_collision_2026_11_03.limitations: Index memory not production-reserved; no global error, self-intersection, full encoded-topology or desktop guarantee.

sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Expose host file service; STL L3-008 thực thi ở M07, không nhầm folder với target.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: First file-lifecycle export: project_state reads the last opened/saved path and the dirty comparison; save_project stages one atomic save that the Controller performs after the command commits through the existing file save path, reporting a failure as a warning while the document stays dirty. No document open/create/replace from a command.
l3_open: write-failure recovery through the plugin path
project load validation and document reload
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: A plugin cannot choose a save destination or replace the document.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Save As request: the plugin asks the host to start its own Save As flow after the command commits; the user chooses the destination and the host performs the atomic save. save and save-as cannot be combined, a busy/failed file operation is a warning, and the plugin never handles a path.
l3_open: write-failure recovery through the plugin path
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: The destination is chosen in the host dialog; the plugin cannot set a path.

sdk_export_plan_policy.rule: Chỉ bề mặt plugin cần (dữ liệu/sự kiện/hành động) mới vào SDK v1; kernel hình học, UI và adapter host nội bộ không vào SDK.
sdk_export_plan_policy.applies_to: L3 files of this owner that have a recorded SDK slice
